# Reboil documentation

Reboil is a TypeScript state library for Expo, React Native, and browser React. It provides composable and lazy feature stores, typed dot-path reads and writes, synchronous partitioned persistence, path-level subscriptions, and development logging without React Context or a Provider.

Recommended reading:
- /docs/overview
- /docs/getting-started/installation
- /docs/getting-started/quick-start
- /docs/getting-started/platform-support
- /docs/concepts/typed-paths
- /docs/concepts/lazy-stores

- /docs/agents
